sections.Profile:
"World Champ" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1957. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, and a central gobble hole.
